items.title: The zero-effort era
items.quote: We are entering a zero-effort era: a traveller gives one precise instruction and the AI carries out every step, from finding the options to booking. That changes what being visible even means.

items.title: Digital that earns its place
items.quote: AI is starting to decide which providers get recommended at all, and it reads your structured data, not your brochure copy. I treat digital presence as ongoing operational work that keeps a destination in the set of options travellers are actually shown, not as a trend to chase.

items.title: Mentoring that survives the real business
items.quote: The distance between having a digital presence and actually using it rarely comes from a lack of skill. It comes from how a small operator is forced to weigh things: seasonality, the pull of personal contact, a fair scepticism about digital. We run workshops and mentoring that start from that reality, so what we cover still holds once people are back at work.

items.title: Tourism, and nothing else
items.quote: I work in tourism and nowhere else. Everything we recommend comes from inside the field, not from a general consulting playbook applied to it. That focus is why the advice holds.
